description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Notify the permissible maximum limits for heavy metals in skin Creams/Lotions and Informations to be marked on packs.
categorisation: This gazette contains two Directions (Nos. 65 and 66) issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. The content establishes regulatory requirements for manufacturers, importers, and distributors of skin creams and lotions, including permissible heavy metal limits and mandatory labeling requirements. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments issued under existing legislation.
